serviceTier.prices.title: Accelerated mode pricing
serviceTier.prices.baseHint: Base prices must use standard processing rates. Tier multipliers apply only to token items.
serviceTier.prices.copyHint: Applying a reference copies base rates, context tiers and mode multipliers. Existing channel prices do not update automatically.
serviceTier.settings.fallback: Use the client request when the upstream provides no valid tier.
serviceTier.cost.legacy: Historical record has no service tier evidence
serviceTier.cost.unconfirmed: Actual processing mode is unconfirmed; billed from the client request.
serviceTier.cost.basePriceOnly: No dedicated price is configured for this mode; base prices apply.
serviceTier.reason.disabled: Service tier billing disabled; base prices apply
serviceTier.reason.legacy: Historical record has no billing evidence
serviceTier.reason.missing_upstream: Upstream tier missing; client request used
serviceTier.reason.conflicting_upstream: Conflicting upstream tiers; client request used
serviceTier.reason.invalid_upstream: Invalid upstream tier; client request used
serviceTier.reason.unpriced_mode: No price configured for this tier
serviceTier.items.officialHint: Ratios scale your base prices; official unit prices remain in USD with no conversion. Unsupported cache durations stay unpriced.
serviceTier.items.applyHint: Replaces mode rules and existing context overrides; schedules inherit. Base prices stay unchanged. Future catalog updates require another explicit application.
serviceTier.items.units: Unit prices per million tokens, displayed in the system currency.
serviceTier.items.inheritHint: Inherit from the active context and mode defaults. Zero is free; explicit unpriced stops inheritance. Editing official rules creates custom pricing.
serviceTier.items.previewHint: No cache or schedule override. Selects context by input size; token mode cost only, before channel multiplier.
